locationComparison.name: Mudskipper Point
notes: Mogres hide in the sand at Mudskipper Point (south of Rimmington); use a fishing explosive on an Ominous Fishing Spot to lure one out.

Skippy and the Mogres unlocks fighting the lured Mogres; since Sailing, ocean Mogres can instead be killed with cannons from a boat, needing neither the miniquest nor fishing explosives (level 32 Slayer required either way).
All defensive bonuses are 0, so any melee weapon is effective; a minor 20% earth weakness exists for a Magic alternative.
Cannonable and safespottable at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring, the western STASH unit, or along the shoreline, including a halberd/cannon safespot); a Protect from Melee altar sits just north.

taskNotes: Mogres require 32 Slayer, combat level 30, and completion of Skippy and the Mogres to be assigned by Mazchna.
slayerTargetId 297 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
A fishing explosive is used on the sand/mud patches at Mudskipper Point to lure each Mogre out; requiredItemId 6664 is Fishing explosive (wiki item infobox id); it is an inventory lure, not worn.
Mogre has 48 Hitpoints, max hit 8 (Crush), 6-tick attack speed, and Defence level 48 with all defensive bonuses 0.

Mogre has a 20% elemental weakness to earth spells; weakness.style is MELEE because all defensive bonuses are 0 and melee is the standard kill, with the minor earth weakness documented for a Magic alternative.
No task extension unlock exists for Mogres.
recommendedMethod: Complete Skippy and the Mogres, then travel to Mudskipper Point (south of Rimmington). Use a fishing explosive on the mud patches to lure a Mogre out of the sand, then kill it with melee. Mogres have no defensive bonuses, so any melee weapon works; the minor 20% earth weakness makes earth spells a viable Magic alternative. Bring food, as they hit up to 8.
